verdict.rationale: The official Manufact MCP server exposes organizations, servers, and deployments as MCP tools, so an agent can programmatically list servers in its own org. API keys are also documented for REST access. However, the public catalog at manufact.com/mcp-catalog is only described as browsable, with no documented query API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: a documented API for querying the public catalog/registry, tool-level discovery across servers, a published REST/OpenAPI reference, and independent corroboration of agent-driven discovery.
